From: helpdesk@microsoft-support.example
Subject: Password expires now
Your Microsoft password expires today. Click the link https://microsoft-support.example/verify and enter your current password.

Subject: Claim your lottery prize
You won a million dollars. Send your bank account and pay the release fee at https://lottery.example/claim immediately.

authored_controls.db2b718552d099e4c7851ae2aea5b174ff905fd6:
From: accounts@amazon-refund.example
Subject: Refund waiting

authored_controls.bb2cf8bca350fbb41a33ce4a038148711204b4cd:
From: it@vpn-check.example
Subject: Mandatory VPN update

authored_controls.90df1950947f70eb86663fa10453780527fb0d7c:

Your Apple account is suspended. Verify your payment card and password immediately at https://apple-recovery.example/login .

Subject: Salary cannot be processed

authored_controls.a5235cd91d4f4f85e2504119cda232f2bd916264:
From: benefits@employee-access.example
Subject: Restore health benefits

Your benefits access is disabled. Enter your company password and current MFA code at https://employee-access.example/restore to restore it.
authored_controls.75c1c440a9fc173f1eebb59fa06a98197d616374:
From: documents@sign-portal.example
Subject: Contract signature required

View your contract by entering your email password at https://sign-portal.example/sign. The form also needs your backup authentication codes.
authored_controls.abee8cfe422ef8b18205756e80da8bb9937c22e5:
From: accounts@invoice-change.example
Subject: New bank instructions

Pay the attached invoice to our replacement bank account today. Do not call the usual finance contact. Submit the transfer receipt at https://invoice-change.example/receipt.
authored_controls.4bcdaa5318624547edd2e4525e916a376580a2df:
From: security@cloud-resync.example
Subject: MFA resynchronization

To avoid lockout, provide your password and one-time authentication code at https://cloud-resync.example/mfa. This will resynchronize your cloud account.
authored_controls.f6f3d0bf328caf56f3f7b2cb56693d168a60add1:
From: help@browser-patch.example
Subject: Required security repair

Turn off antivirus, download the executable from https://browser-patch.example/repair.exe and run it as administrator to prevent your account being deleted.
authored_controls.e4da632b1e3067f38784bcf731e49f3618e39968:
From: refund@tax-rebate.example

Claim your tax refund at https://tax-rebate.example/claim by entering your card number, expiry, security code and bank login password.
authored_controls.6f5adc61ad29890772152a1f17f2950967406212:

Your backup will be deleted unless you verify your login password and recovery codes at https://backup-unlock.example/verify within one hour.
authored_controls.41997e697d7201c02eb55c9089b74e51849e4003:

Pay the release fee at https://customs-charge.example/pay. The payment page requires your card security code and internet banking password.
authored_controls.f23f03d54d00a70ec5e544de3c3ac1dc4d016331:

Install the remote-control client from https://remote-config.example/client.exe, disable endpoint protection, and send your company password to this address.
authored_controls.ba9c68206842d8a8dbdab9bf8eec30061074b2a4:

Subject: Confirm salary destination
